responsibility: Main GNAT-to-GCC translation engine for executable Ada constructs. It owns the conversion of analyzed GNAT syntax trees and front-end tables into GCC trees and functions, tracks per-function translation state such as statement groups, cached unconstrained-array parameter attributes, return-value handling, elaboration procedures, compile-time pragma expressions, and unchecked-conversion validations, and contains specialized lowering such as thunk creation for dispatching/interface calls and the mapping from GNAT operator node kinds to GCC tree codes.
